integrity: The all-dimensional identity is proved analytically from simplex symmetry and an exact Hilbert--Schmidt recurrence. Exact finite enumeration through n=5 is verification only, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Consistent systems with exactly n+1 unit rows forming a regular simplex; unit-relaxation Kaczmarz; fresh independent reshuffling each epoch. No claim for noise, inconsistency, block methods, arbitrary equiangular/tight frames, or finite precision.
title: Exact reshuffling contraction on the regular-simplex Kaczmarz frame
